thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — Billing metering anomaly detected: token_accumulator slope >8% vs reconciliation sample over 20m. Possible duplicate emissions. Playbook: <https://redwood.internal/playbooks/metering-accumulator>

sara: seeing a bunch of overage flags in alerts, two customers already pinged support :exclamation:

mike: which customers and when did this start?

sara: org_45 (redteam-ops), org_88 (payroll-inc). spike begins around 04:12 UTC, correlated with token_count aggregate jump.

anita: running quick diff of emitter->aggregator streams now. early sign: short requests (<=64 tokens) show ~2x counts in aggregator vs emitter sample. suspicious of replay.

ops-oncall: enabling emitter safe-mode (dedupe=true) across eu/us regions now, will monitor for 5m and report.

billing-eng: ack. kicking off live reconcile (window=1h, strategy=conservative) to produce correction delta. ETA ~25m.

kate: if safe-mode cuts the extra tokens we should pause alert generation to avoid more customer noise. can we gate alerts?

jason: tailing consumer traces — saw offset-commit failures in proxy consumer group A causing re-emits. patch ready, can apply quick offset-fix or rollback proxy deploy.

sara: support already sent first-contact emails referencing possible overages. need comms plan if this affects billing.

mike: what's the mitigation path if safe-mode doesn't fully stop drift?

ops-oncall: fallback: disable emitter upstream (use shadow ledger snapshot) and switch billing to shadow-counts. Requires manual approval (eng lead + billing).

billing-eng: understood. preparing adjustment runbooks and customer credit template. will surface preliminary numbers after reconcile.

anita: checking deploy history — proxy v2.3.4 rolled at 04:10 UTC to canary; traces show re-emits after that. rollback looks promising.

jason: initiating rollback of proxy to v2.3.2 in us-east-1 now, will cascade if green.

sara: drafting customer comms template, will share for review (support + legal + finance looped) <https://redwood.internal/incidents/1765439998/comms-draft>

incident-bot: UPDATE: safe-mode enabled at 04:40 UTC. Proxy rollback started at 04:42 UTC. Recon job running. Next automated check in 10m.

mike: keep ops-log updated with exact commands and who ran them. escalate to infra lead if rollback doesn't start reducing replays.

kate: adding potential billing impact tag to ticket: HIGH. not yet customer-facing outage but could generate billability noise.

billing-eng: reconcile progress: 40% scanned, preliminary delta indicates ~6-9% inflated tokens for the 04:10-04:45 window. final will refine.

sara: support note: holding further outbound overage emails pending reconcile results.

anita: post-rollback traces show replay rate falling to baseline in us-east-1. monitoring eu now.

jason: rollback completed in us-east-1 at 04:53 UTC, no further offset errors in traces. rolling to eu.

incident-bot: AUTOMATED: safe-mode + rollback reduced anomaly signal by ~85% in sampled windows. Recon job still finalizing.

mike: good. once reconcile finishes billing-eng prepare proposed credits and I will own customer comms sign-off. postmortem owner?

anita: will own the postmortem and root-cause analysis.

sara: thanks everyone. keeping this thread as the incident canonical chat — update as you have more. :thumbsup:
